name: deepseek-peak-hour-monitoring
description: Shows in the status bar whether you are inside or outside DeepSeek peak hours (pricing/usage) and when the current peak ends. Configurable schedule.

commands.title: DeepSeek Peak Hours: Show status now

deepseekPeak.windowsUtc.description: Peak hour windows in UTC, format "HH:MM-HH:MM" (start before end, within the same day). Default = DeepSeek.

deepseekPeak.weekdays.description: Weekdays on which the peak applies (0 = Sunday, ..., 6 = Saturday). Default Monday to Friday.

deepseekPeak.notifyOnChange.description: Show a notification when the status changes (entering or leaving peak).

deepseekPeak.notifyMinutesBefore.description: Minutes before a status change at which to notify (e.g. "peak ends in ~10 minutes"). 0 = disabled.
